text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein says dialogue is the only means to reach the expected results; calls on everyone to attend to their own business to achieve more for the country.
- King Hussein officially launches celebrations for pumping extra supplies of water from Israel to Jordan; says "our celebration is one of the fruits of peace."
- Jordanian soldier who shot Israeli schoolgirls pleads innocent to charges of premeditated murder; five new lawyers join the defence team.
- Government studies exempting industrial input goods from customs.

- Prime Minister Abdul Salam al-Majali opens local industry exhibition; trade and industry minister says will continue dialogue with the private sector to complete economic legislation. - Record rise in Jordan Cement stock
in the Amman Financial Market on the back of foreign buying.
- King launches water flow from Israel; criticises resignation of union chiefs over new press law.
- British foreign office minister comes to Jordan.
- Jordan urges Ankara to pull out troops from northern Iraq.
